text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —What on earth is going on here~~~~!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san! You promised, didn't you? That 
you'd "bestow upon me the secrets of 
diving"...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh? Was it really like that~? More 
importantly, King, why don't you relax 
with me?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you! I don't have time to mess 
around, not until I've set a record 
befitting a first-class lady!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So, don't hold out on me, tell me the 
secret—
(—Splash!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nahaha~! Keep your eyes on the prize, 
Kiiing!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Aah! Geez! You were panicking about 
your records not improving either, El!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's been so long since I had this 
much fun at a pool! Delightful, 
refreshing, thoroughly satisfying! 
YEEEES!!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I can't keep putting up with this. 
I'll go practice on my own—
(—Splaaash!!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wide open~âª Ahaha, King is soaking wet~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, hehehe...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That is the absolute last straw...! 
Prepare yourselves, all of you!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, talk about flying into a towering 
rage. Well then... let the water gun 
tournament begin~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we completely wore ourselves 
out playing yesterday, didn't we... Good 
grief, what on earth were we doing?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha~... Well, what's done is done, 
yes! Let's just do all the diving practice 
we can!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Wait... My time improved...!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I didn't really feel out of breath... It 
almost felt relaxing, in a way...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ! Could it be—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Because *I* took her to the pool, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That was not merely play— It was to 
help you relax, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"If you stay tense, your stamina won't 
last long! That's why I invited El and the 
others to hang out and refresh... Was I 
wrong?!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, how was it again~? I've forgotten 
already, it was so long ago☆

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You might forget, but I sure won't! I 
refuse to be left owing a debt.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The proud Monstrous Bird never leaves 
a debt unpaid! Now, ask for whatever you 
wish!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, I can ask for anything~? Man, I 
almost feel bad, but thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, mission accomplished! ☆
